supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records do not corroborate the alerted dev.sharma RDP session around 13:42 UTC. The records bounding that time jump from 13:30:21 to 13:43:29; neither records an RDP connection or dev.sharma logon.
At 13:43:29, PROXY-RB-01 resolved FILE-RB-01.riverbend.local to 10.60.20.20. This DNS record does not identify an RDP session, an authenticated user, or subsequent session activity.

Earlier service-ticket requests identify WS-DSHARMA-01$ requesting FILE-RB-01$ tickets from 10.60.10.23. These are machine-account records, not evidence establishing the source or legitimacy of the alerted dev.sharma RDP session.

Retrieve RDP network telemetry and source-endpoint mstsc process and connection records to establish the alerted session's origin.
